content.text: The web lookup tool is unavailable, so I can't fetch live sources; nonetheless: Electric current is measured in amperes because the International System of Units (SI) defines the ampere as the base unit of electric current (with current being the flow of electric charge per second and the ampere fixed in the 2019 SI redefinition). — BIPM, The International System of Units (SI), 9th ed., Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM), 2019.
